title: Tech’s AI Push Risks a Bond Market Blowback: Credit Weekly
title_zh: 科技股人工智能推动债券市场面临反弹风险：《信贷周刊》
summary: Microsoft Corp., Oracle Corp. and other “hyperscalers” are in an arms race to invest in AI and beat competitors in a technology that could change vast parts of the economy. Google parent Alphabet Inc.
summary_zh: 微软公司、甲骨文公司和其他“超大规模企业”正在展开军备竞赛，投资人工智能，并在一项可能改变大部分经济领域的技术上击败竞争对手。谷歌母公司Alphabet Inc.

title: Op-ed: Rotation isn't the answer to the tech uncertainty
title_zh: 专栏：轮换并不是解决技术不确定性的答案
summary: Economist Mohamed El-Erian considers the current tech sell-off brought on by "secular uncertainty" and suggests that swapping one theme for another might not work this time.
summary_zh: 经济学家穆罕默德·埃尔-埃里安认为，当前的科技股抛售是由“长期不确定性”引起的，并表示这次将一个主题换成另一个主题可能行不通。

title: India-US trade deal gives tariff-free access to Harley bikes, no reprieve for Tesla
title_zh: 印美贸易协议给予哈雷摩托车免关税，特斯拉也没有得到缓刑
summary: By Shivangi Acharya NEW DELHI, Feb 7 (Reuters) - India will slash tariffs on high-end American cars to 30% from as high as 110% and eliminate ​duties on Harley-Davidson bikes under an interim trade pact, an official ‌said, but will not make concessions for electric vehicles, a...
summary_zh: 路透新德里 2 月 7 日 - 一位官员表示，印度将根据临时贸易协定将美国高端汽车的关税从高达 110% 削减至 30%，并取消哈雷戴维森自行车的关税，但不会对电动汽车做出让步。

title: Big Tech companies are starting to look like IBM in the 1960s
title_zh: 大型科技公司开始变得像 20 世纪 60 年代的 IBM
summary: The race to dominate the burgeoning AI market is pushing tech giants to adopt business models reminiscent of IBM's in the 1960s.
summary_zh: 为了主导新兴的人工智能市场，科技巨头纷纷采用让人想起 20 世纪 60 年代 IBM 的商业模式。

title: AI chips: How AMD's product pipeline stacks up with competitors
title_zh: AI 芯片：AMD 的产品线如何与竞争对手竞争
summary: While Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock falls in spite of topping fourth quarter estimates and revenue guidance forecasts, Benchmark Company managing director and senior semiconductor research analyst Cody Acre discusses how AMD is positioned to compete with rival chipmakers ...
summary_zh: 虽然 Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 的股价尽管超出第四季度预期和收入指导预测，但仍下跌，但 Benchmark Company 董事总经理兼高级半导体研究分析师 Cody Acre 讨论了 AMD 如何定位与竞争对手芯片制造商竞争......

title: Gold's 'safe haven' that's trading like a meme stock
title_zh: 黄金的“避风港”，其交易就像模因股票
summary: A rough week that battered stocks and crypto also clarified gold's standing, not as a safe-haven asset, but as another investment with volatile, stock-like elements.
summary_zh: 股市和加密货币遭受重创的艰难一周也澄清了黄金的地位，它不是作为避险资产，而是作为另一种具有波动性、类似股票成分的投资。

title: Dow closes above 50,000, Nvidia soars as traders focus on AI spending
title_zh: 道指收于 50,000 点上方，交易员关注人工智能支出，英伟达股价飙升
summary: STORY: The Dow Jones Industrial Average blew past the historic 50,000 mark on Friday, climbing nearly 2.5%, while the S&P 500 gained about 2% and the Nasdaq added more than 2%.Chip stocks led the way, rallying on expectations they would benefit from increased spending on AI da...
summary_zh: 故事：道琼斯工业平均指数周五突破历史性的 50,000 点大关，上涨近 2.5%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨约 2%，纳斯达克指数上涨超过 2%。芯片股领涨，因预期它们将受益于人工智能数据支出的增加而上涨。

title: Consumer Reports' 2026 top 10 cars all have one important feature
title_zh: 《消费者报告》2026 年十大汽车都有一个重要特征
summary: Consumer Reports' top 10 best new cars for 2026 all feature one important feature: hybrid or fully electric power.
summary_zh: 《消费者报告》评选的 2026 年 10 款最佳新车均具有一个重要特征：混合动力或全电动。
